Unmortgaging Tennessee or St James would cost $99 each, but since the orange monopoly isn't complete—New York belongs to Gemini—there's no building advantage, just basic single-property rent to consider.

Gemini has no completed monopolies either, so the danger from their holdings (Pacific, NC, Ventnor, Marvin) stays low; the real threat comes from cards like Street Repairs given how many houses are in play, so I should keep cash on hand rather than unmortgage minor properties. With railroads split between us, unmortgaging B&O or Short Line could meaningfully boost rent if Gemini lands there, so I'm weighing whether that $110 investment is worth it against the odds of them rolling into that zone.
